headline: Cardlytics Appoints Chris Cheng as Chief Legal Officer
summary: ATLANTA, July 29, 2026--Cardlytics Inc. (NASDAQ: CDLX) today announced the appointment of Chris Cheng as Chief Legal Officer, effective August 3, 2026. Cheng will serve on the Leadership Team and oversee Cardlytics Legal and Compliance organization.

headline: Uber Eats Welcomes New Regional Grocery Partners Across the U.S.
summary: SAN FRANCISCO, July 29, 2026--Uber Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: UBER) today announced partnerships with several new grocery retailers across the U.S. This expansion brings beloved regional grocery brands to the Uber Eats marketplace, including Busch’s Fresh Food Market, Hays, Lowe’s Market, and Piggly Wiggly—giving consumers another way to shop the local stores they already know and trust for everyday grocery needs.
